manifest.description: Experimental synchronization plugin built on the Sendspin protocol.

errors.no_players: Select at least one speaker to calibrate.
errors.duplicate_players: Each speaker may only appear once in a calibration session.
errors.player_not_eligible: {0} can not be calibrated: it is not a Sendspin speaker, or its volume can not be controlled.
errors.player_silent: {0} is muted or turned all the way down. Turn it up before calibrating.
errors.player_not_silenced: {0} could not be silenced, so the other speakers can not be measured. Check that it is still reachable and try again.
errors.player_busy: {0} is currently playing. Stop playback first, or start the calibration anyway.
errors.session_already_running: A calibration session is already running.
errors.player_not_in_session: {0} is not part of this calibration session.
errors.no_measurements: No measurements were given to apply.
errors.player_not_measured: {0} was not measured. Measure every speaker in the session before applying the result.
errors.offset_not_finite: The measurement for {0} is not a usable number. Measure it again.
errors.delay_out_of_range: The measurements put {0} {1} ms behind the others, more than the {2} ms Sendspin can correct. Check the measurement rather than the speaker.
errors.sendspin_unavailable: The Sendspin provider is not available.
